rootCause.finding: Two coupled defects distorted the live gate: an unavailable final critic attempt could leave an earlier fail artifact behind, while the only calibration writer ran after commit and therefore could never record a genuinely failed builder run. Treating success+fail as non-contradictory removed the stale false positive but also made real failure evidence unreachable.
contractEvidence: The ordinary write-calibration-artifact step is gated on a committed builder run.

rootCause.disposition: Clear stale critic outcomes before retry, restore the original fail-verdict/failed-run detector, and emit failed-run calibration from the builder terminal finalizer before worktree cleanup. Tighten the critic prompt so evaluator signals that exist only in synthetic fixtures are a critical issue; this prompt change starts an honest fresh sample.
